changelog.name: CameraTools v1.3.2: AOSP Crash Fix, Leica True Tuning & Feature Polish
changelog.body:
## 🚀 CameraTools v1.3.2 — AOSP Crash Fix, Real Leica Color Tuning & Audio Zoom Polish

### 🐛 Critical Bug Fixes & System Stability
* **AOSP ROM Missing Resource Crash Fix (Issue #7)**:
  * Resolved fatal `android.content.res.Resources$NotFoundException: String resource ID #0x7f130379` when opening Camera Settings on Evolution X, LineageOS, crDroid, and other custom AOSP ROMs lacking MIUI framework resource overlays.
  * Implemented resilient dynamic fallback mapping in `hookAospResourceFixes`: safely intercepts `Resources.getString(int)` and `getText(int)` for missing Leica string IDs (such as `0x7f130379` -> `"Leica"`), ensuring camera settings opens seamlessly on any custom ROM without crashing.

---

### 🎙️ Audio Subsystem Polish & State Synchronization
* **Audio Zoom Toggle & Active Indicator Glow Fix**:
  * Resolved issue where tapping the Directional Audio Zoom button in camera UI failed to toggle state or display active visual glow.
  * Eliminated method collision where `isTeleX` hook in `hookFocusPeakingZebra` was inadvertently intercepting audio zoom feature checks.
  * Explicitly initialized `AiAudioParameterManager.sSupported = true` via reflection and hooked `ComponentRunningAiAudioNew.isSwitchOn(int mode)` and `ComponentRunningAiAudioNew.getResIcon(boolean isNormal)` so the audio zoom toggle updates cleanly and displays the active yellow glow indicator.

---

### 🔴 Leica Color Science & Tuning Realism
* **True Leica Authentic vs. Leica Vibrant Separation**:
  * Fixed bug where switching between Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant produced identical images due to `CameraSettings.getCvType()` clamping custom cvType values to `0`.
  * Hooked `CameraSettings.getCvType()` to return the actual user-selected Leica tuning mode (`1` for Leica Authentic, `2` for Leica Vibrant).
  * Enables MIUI Camera's GL rendering pipeline to dynamically bind distinct color grading matrices, contrast S-curves, and peripheral vignette shaders for authentic Leica character.

---

### 🛡️ Strict Mode Conflict Isolation & Guard Architecture
* **Movie Frame (MiMovie 2.39:1) Isolation**:
  * Strictly prevented 2.39:1 anamorphic crop from injecting into incompatible modes: blocked in Portrait (171), Night (173), Panorama (166), Slow Motion (168/172), and Document (186) modes. Eliminates sensor aspect ratio stretching, crop distortion, and preview freezes.
* **50MP Normal Photo Guarding**:
  * Strictly isolated 50MP hardware remosaicing to standard Photo mode (163) on Camera ID `0` (main rear sensor), completely preventing bokeh depth corruption or green tinting in Portrait mode.
* **Pro Shutter & Video LOG Mode Isolation**:
  * Confined extended shutter speed (up to 60s) strictly to Pro Photo (167) and Pro Video (180).
  * Confined flat LOG color profile strictly to Pro Video (180).

---

### 🎞️ Pro RAW Bayer Sensor Hardware Documentation
* **Dual-File Capture Architecture**:
  * Clarified why shooting RAW in Pro mode produces two files: a `.jpg` (ISP-processed preview with color tuning) and a `.dng` (uncompressed raw sensor data with full dynamic range) per the Android Camera2 specification.
* **12.5MP Native Quad-Bayer Readout**:
  * Documented that on the MediaTek Dimensity 1080 (MT6877 / Sony IMX766), the MediaTek Camera HAL exposes RAW at the native 12.5MP 4-in-1 binned Bayer resolution (`RAW_SENSOR` 32). Recommended Adobe Lightroom / Photoshop with custom color profiles for optimal DNG post-processing.

---

### 📦 Release Verification & Hashes
* **Package Name**: `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`
* **Version Code**: `132`
* **Version Name**: `1.3.2`
* **SHA256 (`io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.2.apk`)**: `036BFFE28D60C82B470D36E44F9737542843A7C25A638020E3EE49EFA3A7A310`
* **Signing Scheme**: APK Signature Scheme v3 (Valid, Signed with Arvind's Release Key)
* **Target Device**: Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G / Discovery (`ruby` / `rubypro`)
* **OS Support**: Android 13 & Android 14 (Stock HyperOS / MIUI & AOSP Custom ROMs)

changelog.name: CameraTools v1.3.1: Security Hardening, 15 Features & Modern Logo
changelog.body:
# CameraTools v1.3.1 — AOSP Preference Loading & LSPosed API 93 Fix (Pre-Release)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Hotfix Pre-Release for AOSP ROMs & Vector / LSPosed Users**:  
> In v1.3.0, users running AOSP ROMs (such as **Evolution X**, **crDroid**, and **LineageOS**) with **Vector** or modern **LSPosed** reported that preferences toggled in the UI were not applied to `com.android.camera` at runtime (`exists=false canRead=false` in diagnostic logs).  
> 
> **Version 1.3.1 completely resolves this with our new 4-Tier Bulletproof Preference Architecture.**

---

### 🚀 What's Changed in v1.3.1:

#### 1. LSPosed API 93 RemotePreferences (Non-Root & Root)
* Declared `xposedminversion="93"` and `xposedsharedprefs="true"` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
* Module UI saves preferences via `Context.MODE_WORLD_READABLE`, redirected automatically by LSPosed API 93 into a shared cross-process IPC directory (`/data/misc/.../prefs/io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`).
* `HookMain` instantiates `new XSharedPreferences("io.github.official_arvind.cameratools", PrefProvider.PREFS_NAME)`, bypassing Android 14 filesystem DAC/MAC sandbox restrictions entirely.

#### 2. Automated SELinux Root Sync Bridge
* Added `syncPrefsWithRoot()` in `MainActivity`: dynamically discovers target camera package UID (`stat -c %u`), creates target directories, copies the XML config, sets `chmod 666`, applies `chown`, and runs `restorecon -F` to ensure full SELinux compliance.
* Guarantees that `/data/data/com.android.camera/shared_prefs/cameratools_prefs.xml` exists, is readable, and has matching SELinux contexts.

#### 3. Android 11+ Package Visibility Bypass
* Added `grantCameraUriPermissions()` in `MainActivity` to explicitly grant `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` across all 13 supported camera packages (`com.android.camera`, `com.miui.camera`, GCam packages, Aperture, GrapheneOS Camera, OpenCamera).

#### 4. Multi-Tier Fallback Provider
* Completely revamped `PrefProvider`'s `loadAllBooleans()` to traverse Device-Protected storage (DE), Credential-Protected storage (CE), and fallback XML directly, preventing default `false` returns.

#### 5. Live Lifecycle Preference Reloading
* Added hooks on `Application.onCreate` and `Activity.onResume` in `HookMain` to reload settings immediately when switching between CameraTools and the camera application without requiring a full zygote reboot.

---

### 📋 Instructions for Tester Jay & AOSP Users:

1. **Install Update**: Install `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.1.apk`.
2. **Grant Superuser**: Open **CameraTools** and tap **Grant** (Always Allow) when prompted by Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch.
3. **Verify LSPosed / Vector Scope**: In LSPosed/Vector manager, ensure **CameraTools** is enabled and `com.android.camera` (and your other camera apps) are checked in the scope.
4. **Configure & Restart**: Toggle your desired settings (e.g., 50MP RAW, 4K60, Bitrate) and tap **Restart Camera** inside the app.
5. **Verify Logs**:
   ```bash
   adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge
   ```
   You should now see:
   ```
   [CameraTools] Successfully loaded preferences via LSPosed API 93 XSharedPreferences: raw=true, 50MP=true, 4k60=true
   ```
   or
   ```
   [CameraTools] Preferences updated via ContentProvider: raw=true, 50MP=true
   ```

---

### 📦 Checksums & Verification:
* **APK Filename**: `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.1.apk`
* **Version Code**: `131`
* **Version Name**: `1.3.1`
* **Min Xposed API**: `93`
* **Signature**: Android APK Signature Scheme v2 & v3 verified

changelog.name: v1.3.0 - AOSP ROM Compatibility Pre-Release
changelog.body:
## 🚀 CameraTools v1.3.0: Universal AOSP ROM & Framework Hooks Pre-Release

Welcome to **CameraTools v1.3.0**! This major milestone expands compatibility beyond stock MIUI/HyperOS to custom AOSP ROMs and alternative camera applications.

---

### 🔑 Important: Superuser (Root) Permissions Required
CameraTools requires and utilizes **Root Access (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)**. When launching the app, please tap **Grant / Always Allow**:
* **Direct Sandbox Preference Sync**: Seamlessly syncs configuration XML files into the target camera application's private directory (`/data/data/com.android.camera/shared_prefs/`), bypassing Android 13/14 cross-package SELinux restrictions.
* **Instant One-Click Camera Restart**: Tapping *Restart Camera* runs `su -c am force-stop` on target camera packages so newly enabled features apply instantly without rebooting the phone.

---

### 🌟 What's New & Highlighted Features

#### 1. Universal Android Framework (`android.hardware.camera2` & `android.media`) Hooks
* CameraTools now hooks directly into Android Framework classes (`CameraCharacteristics`, `MediaRecorder`, `CamcorderProfile`, `PowerManager`).
* Enables features across **Xiaomi Camera**, **Google Camera (GCam)** ports, and **AOSP Camera apps**.

#### 2. Expanded Camera Ecosystem Support
* **Xiaomi Official & Ported MiuiCamera** (`com.android.camera`, `com.miui.camera` on HyperOS, MIUI, or ported to LineageOS/crDroid)
* **Google Camera (GCam) Ports** (BSG MGC, AGC, Shamim SGCAM, Snapcam)
* **Standard AOSP Cameras** (Aperture, Open Camera, AOSP Camera2)

#### 3. Core Feature Suite
* 🎥 **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Smooth 4K recording at 60 FPS on the rear Sony IMX766 sensor.
* 🎬 **150 Mbps Cinematic Bitrate**: Studio broadcast-grade bitrate for pristine video capture.
* 🎞️ **50MP Full Bayer RAW Capture (DNG)**: True uncompressed 50MP RAW in Pro Mode.
* 🔴 **Leica Authentic & Vibrant Profiles**: Official Leica color tuning and Leica watermarks unlocked without region restrictions.
* 👥 **Dual-Camera Concurrent Stream (Director Mode 204)**: Simultaneous front and rear sensor capture with MediaTek PIP vendor tag support.
* ⏱️ **Extended Pro Exposure Range (60s – 1/16000s)**: Ultra-long 60s shutter for astrophotography down to 1/16000s for freezing action.
* ❄️ **Hardware Thermal Warning & Forced Shutdown Bypass**: Neutralizes thermal throttling so recording never stops due to device temperature.
* 🔍 **50MP Normal Photo Mode**: Seamless MediaTek ISP hardware remosaicing in standard Photo mode (strictly bound to rear Camera 0).

---

### 📢 Calling AOSP ROM Testers!
We invite users running custom AOSP ROMs (LineageOS, crDroid, Evolution X, PixelOS, DerpFest, RisingOS) on the Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G (`ruby` / `rubypro`) to test this pre-release:

1. Enable **CameraTools** in LSPosed / Vector.
2. Ensure your camera app (e.g. `com.android.camera`, `org.lineageos.aperture`, or GCam) is added to the module **Scope**.
3. Launch CameraTools, grant root access, toggle desired features, and tap **Restart Camera**.
4. Capture logs if needed:
   ```bash
   adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge
   ```
5. Share feedback and report any bugs on our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/issues)!

---

### 📦 Package Verification
* **File**: `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools-v1.3.0.apk`
* **Target Device**: Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G / Pro+ 5G / Discovery (`ruby` / `rubypro`, MT6877)
* **Minimum Android**: Android 13+ (API 33+)
* **Framework**: LSPosed / Vector (API 93+)
* **SHA-256**: `BE221BAC5EA49E4B980095532105678B3DEF36EE5F9AEFC75103CE5221532663`

﻿## 🎬 CameraTools v1.1.0 Release Notes

### 🚀 What's New in v1.1.0:
- **Dual Video (Director Mode / Mode 204) UNLOCKED & FULLY WORKING**:
  - Unlocked simultaneous front (OV16A1Q) + rear (Sony IMX766) multi-camera concurrent streaming and recording on Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby / MediaTek Dimensity 1080 MT6877).
  - Bypassed HAL multi-camera restrictions (onValidateOpenLocked return bypass and max concurrent stream bump).
  - Fixed MediaTek session operating mode (rewriting vendor Qualcomm session types 0x9005 to standard Android SESSION_REGULAR).
  - Added hooks for DualVideoModuleUtil, ComponentRunningDualVideo, and Checker hardware bypass.
  - Cleaned up debug method tracing for optimal camera responsiveness.
- **Modernized Dashboard UI & Verified Package Structure**:
  - Full OLED-dark UI dashboard with per-feature colored pill badges, haptic feedback, and smart Enable/Disable All toggle.
  - Updated verified module ID to `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`.

### 🌟 All Features Included:
1. **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Unlocks true 3840x2160 @ 60 FPS recording with 60 FPS toggle switch.
2. **Cinematic Ultra Bitrate (150 Mbps)**: Boosts 4K video recording up to 150 Mbps HEVC for studio master quality.
3. **50MP Full Bayer RAW (DNG)**: Enables true 50-megapixel uncompressed RAW sensor capture in Pro Mode.
4. **Leica Authentic & Vibrant Profiles + Branded Watermark**: Injects official Leica color profiles and branding.
5. **Dual-Camera Concurrent Stream (Director Mode)**: Full concurrent front + rear recording.
6. **Extended Pro Exposure Range**: 60s long exposure astrophotography down to 1/16000s shutter.
7. **Complete Thermal Warning & Shutdown Bypass**: Prevents camera close dialogs or recording halts under high temperature.

**我们需要您的反馈！** 我们专门设计了 CameraTools 来支持自定义 ROM，例如 **LineageOS**、**crDroid**、**Evolution X**、**PixelOS**、**DerpFest** 和 **RisingOS**。 ### 如何在 AOSP 上测试： 1. **安装模块**： * 从 [Releases](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/releases) 下载并安装最新的 `v1.3.2` APK。 2. **授予超级用户（Root）权限**： * 打开 **CameraTools** 应用程序。当 Magisk、KernelSU 或 APatch 提示时，点击 **授予**（始终允许），以便应用程序可以将设置直接同步到目标相机数据目录并执行快速相机重新启动。 3. **在 LSPosed / Vector 中启用**： * 打开您的 Xposed 管理器（LSPosed、Vector 等）。 * 启用 **CameraTools** 模块。 * **关键步骤 - 验证模块范围**： * 对于 **移植的 MiuiCamera**：确保在范围内选中 `com.android.camera` 或 `com.miui.camera`。 * 对于 **GCam**：确保已检查已安装的 GCam 软件包（例如 `com.android.MGC`、`com.agc.cam`、`com.shamim.cam`）。 * 对于 **AOSP 相机**：确保选中“org.lineageos.aperture”、“net.sourceforge.opencamera”或“com.android.camera2”。 4. **配置设置**： * 打开 **CameraTools** 应用程序并切换您要测试的功能。 * 点击应用程序内的**重新启动相机**。 5. **捕获并提交诊断日志**： * 通过 USB 将手机连接到 PC，并启用 USB 调试。 * 启动相机应用程序并在终端中运行以下命令： ````bash adb logcat -s CameraTools VectorLegacyBridge ```` * 如果应用程序崩溃，捕获崩溃堆栈跟踪： ````bash adb logcat -b 崩溃 ```` 6. **提交反馈**： * 在我们的 [GitHub 问题跟踪器](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/issues) 上打开一个问题： * 您的 ROM 名称和 Android 版本（例如 *crDroid 10.x、Android 14*）。 * 相机应用程序经过测试和软件包版本。 * 来自“adb logcat -s CameraTools”的输出。 --- ## 🛠️ 安装和设置摘要
